Description:
  srndx - offline semantic search over local files and git history. Pure managed: FastText.Net (language ID) + Model2Vec.Net (embeddings) + Hnsw.Net (vector index). No native dependency, no GPU, no cloud.

Usage:
  srndx [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Commands:
  index           Build a search index from local files and/or git history.
  search <query>  Search an index built by 'index'.
  serve           Run as a service: keep an index in sync with a watched directory and answer queries.
  mcp             Run as an MCP server over stdio, exposing a 'search' tool backed by a live, self-updating index.
  stop            Stop a resident 'serve'/'mcp' process holding an index, flushing it first.
  install-mcp     Register srndx as an MCP server in a repository so agents can use its live 'search' tool.
  install-skill   Emit an Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that tells an agent how to use the srndx CLI.

result.stdout:
Description:
  Build a search index from local files and/or git history.

Usage:
  srndx index [options]

Options:
  -f, --files <files>                  Directory of text/source files to index (recursively).
  -g, --git <git>                      Path to a git repository whose commit history should be indexed.
  --max-commits <max-commits>          Maximum number of commits to read from --git. [default: 500]
  -o, --out <out> (REQUIRED)           Path to write the index file.
  --ef-construction <ef-construction>  HNSW build beam width (default 200). Lower values index faster with slightly lower vector recall. [default: 200]
  --shards <shards>                    Number of vector shards to build in parallel (default 8). More shards index, load, and query with more parallelism. [default: 8]
  -?, -h, --help                       Show help and usage information

Description:
  Search an index built by 'index'.

Usage:
  srndx search <query> [options]

Arguments:
  <query>  The natural-language query to search for.

Options:
  -i, --index <index> (REQUIRED)  Path to an index file produced by 'index'.
  -l, --lang <lang>               Restrict results to a language (ISO code, e.g. en, fr, de).
  -s, --source <file|git>         Restrict results to a source: file or git.
  -n, --top <top>                 Number of results to return. [default: 5]
  -?, -h, --help                  Show help and usage information

Description:
  Run as a service: keep an index in sync with a watched directory and answer queries.

Usage:
  srndx serve [options]

Options:
  -f, --files <files> (REQUIRED)  Directory of text/source files to watch and index (recursively).
  -i, --index <index> (REQUIRED)  Index file to maintain. Loaded if it exists, otherwise built from --files.
  --debounce <debounce>           Milliseconds to coalesce a burst of file changes before re-indexing. [default: 500]
  -?, -h, --help                  Show help and usage information

result.stdout:
Description:
  Register srndx as an MCP server in a repository so agents can use its live 'search' tool.

Usage:
  srndx install-mcp [options]

Options:
  -r, --repo <repo>    Target repository directory. [default: .]
  --path <path>        Config file to write (default: <repo>/.github/mcp.json).
  --name <name>        MCP server name to register. [default: srndx]
  --command <command>  Executable to invoke (default: the current srndx executable).
  -i, --index <index>  Index file the server should maintain (default: <repo>/.github/srndx.idx).
  -?, -h, --help       Show help and usage information
